text:
mahesh: heads up — I spotted a regression in the kernel selection path on a subset of machines (SM 7.5 / A10s). seqlen=256 workloads have ~18% drop in tokens/sec vs yesterday. logs point at a different kernel being chosen for batches > 8. digging.

elena: yea saw that in the nightly perf dashboard. p99 is up too. suspect the auto-detect is preferring the non-TC path for some runs.

perf-bot: microbench snapshot attached:
```
host: a10g-03
sm: 75
workload: seqlen=256, batch=16
kernel-chosen: attention_v1_generic
tokens/sec: 62k (baseline 75k)
p99-token-latency: 48ms (baseline 32ms)
kv-cache-hits: 87% -> 72% during spikes
```

josh: that kernel name is our fallback generic path (no tensor cores). Why is the probe not selecting fast-attn-tc? any recent probe changes?

mahesh: we pushed a small probe tweak that tightened the FP8/BF16 capability check last week (to avoid driver crashes). maybe that made some A10s appear 'incompatible' incorrectly.

anika: I can repro locally on an A10 emu. minimal repro script: 
```
# repro
./run_microbench --model gpt-small --seq 256 --batch 16 --probe-sm
# check selected kernel in logs
grep "kernel-chosen" /tmp/microbench.log
```

elena: also noticed kv-cache thrash for batch>12 — prefetching was disabled when kernel fallback occurs, so prefix cache misses jump and effective throughput falls. not purely kernel perf.

josh: ok two issues: (1) probe false-negative on tensor-core support, (2) fallback path disables prefetch. both compound.

mahesh: quick mitigation: we can add an override env var REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=fast-attn-tc for the specific fleet tag while we fix probe. should be low risk if we gate by sm>=75 and driver>=520.

anika: test patch ready: added relaxed fp8 capability check and restored prefetch flag for fallback kernel. posted PR: https://git.redwood/infra/attn-probe/pull/712

perf-bot: CI microbench results for PR712:
```
sm75 emu: tokens/sec +10% vs baseline
batch=16 seqlen=256: p99 34ms -> 30ms
kv-cache miss-rate down 5pps
```

elena: nice. can we run a 4h canary on the affected pool before rolling? request to SRE to stage 50 nodes.

josh: also add a regression test to the autotuner that simulates mixed SM signatures so this doesn't regress silently.

mahesh: action items
- mahesh: push REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL override to canary tag (today)
- anika: follow up on PR comments and run 4h canary (today afternoon)
- josh: add autotuner regression test (EOW)
- elena: monitor kv-cache metrics and p99 during canary (today)

anika: noted — will post canary link and logs in this thread. pairing with mahesh at 3pm to validate host filters.

mahesh: thanks. FYI I'll also run through a small audit to see if any other capability-check tightenings landed in last 2 weeks.

elena: great — ping here once canary starts. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: ticket created: INF-2248 "SM probe false-negative + kv-prefetch disable causing seqlen=256 perf regression". linking PR712 and canary when available.
